name: PixeAI - AI Video Photo Editor
metaDescription: PixeAI is an AI photo editor and video maker for iPhone and iPad: turn photos and footage into AI videos, and create art from an image and a prompt.
description:
PixeAI is a one of the best AI Photo editing and AI Videos maker apps using AI with a mission to make your editing easy, smooth and fun.

AI VIDEO GENERATOR
Transform your photos into captivating videos with PixeAI, the ultimate AI video generator app! Unleash your creativity and bring your imagination to life using the power of artificial intelligence with deforum stable diffusion technology. With PixeAI, you can create professional videos in just minutes, without the need for cameras, microphones, or actors.

PixeAI empowers you to generate mesmerizing videos from any image or footage. Utilizing advanced AI algorithms, the app intelligently analyzes and enhances your content, transforming it into vibrant and visually stunning AI videos.

• ► Create art from images
Start with an image as a visual base for your prompt. Upload a photo or select one from our library, and watch our AI transform it into a masterpiece tailored to your vision. Transform photos of your partners or bring your kids artwork to life. Enjoy your AI Generated photos & images.

• ► Get Inspired & Explore Artwork
Save your artwork to your profile so that you can view it for later, it’s that simple! Get an extra boost of inspiration by browsing the public gallery of amazing images generated by AI artists from all over the world. Explore and like the ideas of others and get your creative juices flowing!

ONE-TOUCH OBJECT REMOVAL: Say goodbye to photobombers, unwanted elements, or distracting objects in your pictures. With just a single touch, PixeAI intelligently analyzes your photo and seamlessly removes any undesired elements, leaving behind a clean and polished image.

IMAGE ENHANCEMENT: Elevate your photo quality with PixeAI powerful image enhancement tools. Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and more to bring out the hidden details and make your images truly captivating. Enhance colors, sharpen edges, and create a professional finish with ease.

ARTISTIC FILTERS and ANIME EFFECTS: Unleash your artistic side with a wide range of filters and effects. Transform your photos into stunning works of art with a single tap. From vintage to modern, black and white to vibrant colors, PixeAI offers a plethora of options to suit your unique style.

BACKGROUND REMOVAL MADE EASY: Need to change the backdrop of your photo? No problem! PixeAI offers a seamless background removal feature that allows you to isolate the main subject with incredible precision. Replace the background with a solid color, a custom image, or a transparent background for endless creative possibilities.

HIGH-QUALITY RESULTS: PixeAI utilizes cutting-edge algorithms to deliver high-quality results without compromising on detail or resolution. Your edited photos will retain their clarity and sharpness, ensuring that every detail shines through.

Unlock the potential of AI and transform your photos into captivating works of art with PixeAI. Download the app today and unlock a new realm of possibilities in video creation. Get ready to leave your audience spellbound with your unique and stunning video content.
